verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online explicitly documents inviting an accountant with direct access to books (quickbooks-docs-10) and offers custom role-based access controls for users (quickbooks-docs-4, quickbooks-docs-25), directly matching the founder story of adding an external accountant with scoped permissions to review/adjust books. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the specific 'Accountant' user role permissions/limits vs regular custom roles, and independent/hands-on confirmation that scoped access works as described
